title: SABR: Spacer Alignment-Based Recognition
description: SABR is a Streamlit bioinformatics tool for mapping CRISPR spacer-targeting evidence against bacteriophages and reporting repeat-derived CRISPR-Cas subtype support with PAM/PFS-aware interpretation. SABR reports computational evidence layers and does not make definitive phenotype-level phage resistance claims.
